title: The First Night in Miryang
teaser: Your first task: protect the new magistrate.
text: The previous magistrates died mysteriously on their first night. A rookie reaper is sent to protect the fourth and investigate the spirit haunting the office.

title: A Trace in the Bamboo
teaser: Find the story the spirit wants to tell.
text: After calming the terrified guard, the reaper discovers a trace in the grove. The mirror can be kept in storage or placed in the bag.

title: Meeting Arang
teaser: Consider what Arang wanted to reveal.
text: Arang is more than a fearsome spirit: she wants someone to hear the injustice she suffered. Bring the evidence in your bag to show it to her.

title: The End of the First Night
teaser: Record the choices of the night.
text: The first night in Miryang is over. The reaper records what was seen and heard, and the story left untold.
